layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.

Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Light: the sun is low in the south-west, at the bottom left of the image: faces turned to the left or to the viewer are lit, faces turned to the right are in shadow, snow is brightest on its left side, and nothing is lit from the right.

Class: one chunky cute unit figure with a big head, short sturdy body and one oversized signature weapon or tool, thick single-colour black outline, standing ready pose, both feet visible; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.

Subject: Chieftain, a chunky cute caveman chief riding a lean deep blue raptor, rider and mount filling the whole width of the image: the chief has a huge round head, golden tan skin, a wild black mane and beard, a goofy grin, a tall crown of bright orange feathers on a bone-white headband, orange war paint on the cheeks, a tawny fur cape with big dark brown spots, and a huge cream bone club raised high. The raptor runs on two strong legs: a dark navy back, a cream belly and claws, a big friendly long-snouted head, an orange feather crest, bold orange tiger stripes and a long stiff tail.
